doubts.claim_under_doubt: one logged override covers both enforcement points

doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Name an expired or HEAD-mismatched token in the block text. ADDRESSED: claim() returns the reason, shown in the BLOCKED advice, tested.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the git-side check only adds a second enforcement point for already-gated commits

ADDRESSED as a disclosed limit: measured 21/21 (100%) against a 70% threshold in this repo; a block can only come from a genuinely below-threshold staged manifest.
